serverInfo.name: soccer-mcp
serverInfo.title: Soccer MCP — Fixtures, Settlement & Honest Odds Math

description: Football fixtures, results, de-vig odds math, Kelly/EV pricing, pick settlement, and Team-Mood news sentiment per club (LLM-scored, with sources). Sentiment scores are model-assisted (LLM per-factor deltas, freshness- and source-weighted) — mood indicators, not betting advice.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Every football match on a day (YYYY-MM-DD), all competitions, with scores when played

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Finished matches with final score — the input for settling bets

tools.name: settle_picks
tools.description: Settle a list of picks against real scorelines: per-pick result, hit rate, PnL, ROI

tools.name: devig_market
tools.description: Strip the bookmaker margin (power method) and return fair probabilities

tools.name: evaluate_price
tools.description: Fair odds, EV, minimum odds, scaled Kelly stake, take-it verdict

tools.name: get_team_sentiment
tools.description: Team-Mood cards: net news sentiment per club (-1..+1), level, trend, hard absences, factor list with sources

tools.name: engine_status
tools.description: Whether the optional private engine bridge is wired up
